content.text:
The v4 docs here don't have a plugin-authoring guide. The only plugin coverage is about loading plugins.

- **Loading:** `src/docs/functions-and-directives.mdx`, section "@plugin directive" (~line 296–306). It says `@plugin` loads a "legacy JavaScript-based plugin", from a package name or a local path, for example `@plugin "@tailwindcss/typography";`.
- **Compatibility:** the same file, ~line 280 (the `@config`/`@plugin` compatibility section), says plugins can be combined with `@theme`, `@utility` and other CSS-driven features. Things defined in CSS take precedence over those in configs and plugins.
- **Creating:** I found no v4 page on writing plugins or the plugin API (`addUtilities`, `matchUtilities` and so on). Those only appear in old v1–v3 blog posts. So the docs don't say whether the JS plugin API is still supported, but the "legacy" wording and the `@plugin` loader suggest it still works. For new work, the CSS-first directives (`@utility`, `@custom-variant`) seem to be the intended route.
